models.name: EMOVA (Qwen2.5-7B)
models.notes: The linked open release uses Qwen2.5-7B for image understanding and expressive speech interaction. The figure describes the EMOVA family; license evidence applies to this Qwen checkpoint.

sources.title: EMOVA: Empowering Language Models to See, Hear and Speak with Vivid Emotions

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.architecture: Hybrid-attention language backbone with vision and audio encoders
models.notes: The verified E4B instruction-tuned checkpoint accepts text, images, video frames and audio, and generates text. The family figure also covers other sizes; this entry selects E4B.

sources.title: Gemma 4 model overview | Google AI for Developers
Audio understanding | Gemma | Google AI for Developers

models.name: HumanOmniV2
models.notes: Extends the HumanOmni line with multimodal reasoning training.

sources.title: HumanOmniV2: From Understanding to Omni-Modal Reasoning with Context

models.name: LongCat-Flash-Omni
models.architecture: MoE with perception and speech modules
models.notes: Real-time audiovisual interaction built on the LongCat-Flash backbone.

models.name: LongCat-Next
models.notes: Models multiple modalities through token sequences; check the report for individual generation paths.

sources.title: LongCat-Next: Lexicalizing Modalities as Discrete Tokens

models.name: Megrez-Omni
models.notes: Megrez-3B-Omni is the multimodal member; Megrez-3B-Instruct is text-only.

models.name: MiMo-V2.5
models.notes: Native multimodal understanding on the MiMo-V2-Flash backbone.

models.name: Ming-Flash-Omni
models.notes: Extends the Ming family with image tasks and joint acoustic generation.

sources.title: Ming-Flash-Omni: A Sparse, Unified Architecture for Multimodal Perception and Generation

models.name: Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0
models.notes: Supports speech, sound and music synthesis alongside image generation and editing.

models.name: Ming-Lite-Omni
models.notes: The publicly released Ming-Lite-Omni checkpoint covers multimodal perception, speech and image generation. This entry selects the Lite release from the broader Ming-Omni research family.

sources.title: Ming-Omni: A Unified Multimodal Model for Perception and Generation

models.name: Mini-Omni2
models.notes: Adds visual input and interruption-aware duplex interaction to Mini-Omni.

sources.title: Mini-Omni2: Towards Open-source GPT-4o with Vision, Speech and Duplex Capabilities

models.name: MiniCPM-o 2.6
models.notes: The 2.6 omni release supports speech and audiovisual interaction.

models.name: MiniCPM-o 4.5
models.notes: Adds simultaneous seeing, listening and speaking with proactive behavior.

sources.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5: Towards Real-Time Full-Duplex Omni-Modal Interaction

models.name: MiniMind-O
models.notes: The released MiniMind-3O checkpoint combines text, vision and speech within a small Thinker–Talker system.

sources.title: MiniMind-O Technical Report: An Open Small-Scale Speech-Native Omni Model

models.name: Ola
models.notes: Uses video as a bridge for joint image, video and audio understanding.

sources.title: Ola: Pushing the Frontiers of Omni-Modal Language Model

models.name: Omni-AutoThink
models.notes: Adjusts reasoning behavior across text, audio and visual tasks.

models.name: Phi-4-multimodal
models.notes: The multimodal release accepts audio and vision; Phi-4-mini is a separate text model.

sources.title: Phi-4-Mini Technical Report: Compact yet Powerful Multimodal Language Models via Mixture-of-LoRAs

models.name: Qwen2.5-Omni
models.notes: Processes audiovisual inputs and produces streaming speech with text.

models.name: Qwen3-Omni
models.notes: The verified Instruct checkpoint includes Thinker and Talker, supporting visual/audio understanding and speech output.

models.notes: The selected release is the complete 7B checkpoint of the audio-visual 2+ generation. The paper and figure describe the broader caption-enhanced video-SALMONN 2 family.
